page_title: NEW 2-2 CHE | Newcastle v Chelsea 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Andy Madley is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Reece James (Chelsea) looks relieved after the referee decides on no action against him after the VAR review.

90+6' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Reece James (Chelsea), but referee Andy Madley must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+4' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
90+2' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Here's the change. Jacob Ramsey leaves the pitch and Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
89' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
88' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:3.
88' The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
86' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
85' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
83' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' The referee is firm and issues Andrey Santos (Chelsea) a deserved yellow card.
82' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

82' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Aaron Ramsdale guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
81' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
79' Substitution. Andrey Santos (Chelsea) on for Cole Palmer.
79' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Robert Sanchez reads it well and gathers the ball.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' The total number of attempts is 8:9.
74' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
73' Substitution. Jacob Murphy leaves the pitch and is replaced by Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
73' Here is a change. Nick Woltemade is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd).
72' Substitution. Anthony Gordon did his best and is replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
72' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
70' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
69' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
68' The ball possession at the moment is 48:52.
66' 2 - 2 Goal! The ball breaks to Joao Pedro (Chelsea) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 2:2.
65' One of the players from Newcastle times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Chelsea win a corner.
61' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
58' Enzo Maresca appears to have said too much and referee Andy Madley comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.

58' What a wasted opportunity by Pedro Neto (Chelsea)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
57' The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Wow, what an escape. Reece James (Chelsea) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
54' It is time for a substitution. Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is on for Malo Gusto.
53' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
53' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes it short.
51' Some great controlled play and passing from Newcastle. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

49' 2 - 1 Reece James (Chelsea) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball goalwards and it bounces in off the left post.
48' Chelsea are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+3' What an opportunity! Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
45+2' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
45' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
44' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
43' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Andy Madley due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Pedro Neto (Chelsea) and his team.

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Chelsea are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
40' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Chelsea, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' 5:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
34' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
32' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
30' Chelsea keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

28' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez makes a nice save.
27' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
26' The possession of the ball – 49:51.
24' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Newcastle players have a reason to celebrate!
22' Wait! Referee Andy Madley has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
20' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Gordon plays it into the box, and Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
18' Handball by Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd).
16' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
15' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Robert Sanchez has no trouble gathering it.

15' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
13' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
12' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
11' Some neat passing and movement from Chelsea as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
9' The corner by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing. Newcastle have a corner.
7' The referee shows a yellow card to Robert Sanchez (Chelsea). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.

7' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the roof of the net, but Robert Sanchez reacts superbly to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
6' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
4' CHANCE! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez produces an excellent save.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Andy Madley will officiate today.
